title: bug: postflight-vm-route.ps1's snapshot helpers (Get-VmcControl, Get-VmcWFiles, Get-VmcWIndex, from 99d39004 / CQ-M07n2) call Get-FileHash, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot resolve when node starts it under pwsh, so on CI's Windows PowerShell 5.1 leg postflight.ps1 fails at its VM-route call ("VM route scenarios failed") and no 5.1 VM-route row runs
description:
Filed by hunt #22 (task-7a3640da), from a dry run of CI's windows-latest leg on the Windows host, at fec9a842 and re-checked at 2037e856.

PROBLEM
- scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1's snapshot helpers call Get-FileHash three times:
  - Get-VmcControl hashes the control checkout's .git\index;
  - Get-VmcWFiles hashes every file under W;
  - Get-VmcWIndex hashes W's index.
  These are lines 353, 364 and 368 at fec9a842, and 488, 499 and 503 at 2037e856. 99d39004 (task-d861f3de, CQ-M07n2, 2026-11-03) added them.
- CI's step "Test Windows PowerShell wrapper postflight" (ci.yml:317-322) runs `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell` from a pwsh step. node starts powershell.exe 5.1 on postflight.ps1, which at :6143 runs `& $psExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File postflight-vm-route.ps1`.
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 started by node under pwsh inherits pwsh's PSModulePath, so it cannot autoload Get-FileHash (mem:gotcha-ps51-under-node-under-pwsh-psmodulepath).
  - postflight.ps1:2205-2207 records that this already threw on the real windows-latest runner (Scenario Y).
  - moe-agent.ps1:531-533 avoids Get-FileHash for the same reason (Get-MoeSha256Hex).
- So the first VM-route row ("[vm candidate] R1") throws, postflight-vm-route.ps1 exits 2, and postflight.ps1 fails with "VM route scenarios failed".
- Until 7811de41 (task-e45da220) landed today, the 5.1 harness stopped earlier, at its worktree suite (:1244-1245), so it never reached this call. At 2037e856 nothing earlier masks it. pwsh 7 is not affected.

EVIDENCE (Windows node 24.16.0, powershell 5.1.26100, pwsh 7.6.9; runner-like environment; Windows-git clones outside the shared checkout)
- Full 5.1 postflight at fec9a842 (pass 3), same chain as CI. MOE_WORKTREE_ONLY=config-fail stood in for e45da220's fix, and GITHUB_ACTIONS was unset only so that scenario AE skips symlinks, which this host cannot create. Result:
  - summary {"engine":"powershell","exit":1,"lastScenario":"Z","failureClass":"HARNESS_FAILURE","failureLine":6144};
  - every scenario from A through AM, the commit-scope scenarios, WT-14 and [protected runtime] were ok;
  - the stderr then reads:
    The term 'Get-FileHash' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program. ...
    MOE_POSTFLIGHT_FAILURE_LINE=6144
    D:\moe-scratch\h22\p5\scripts\tests\postflight.ps1 : VM route scenarios failed
  Log: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/logs/p5c-postflight-ps1-full.log
- The same pass on pwsh 7 printed "PASS postflight-vm-route.ps1" and "PASS postflight.ps1" with failureClass NONE (logs/p7c-postflight-pwsh-full.log).
- Isolation, both at fec9a842 and at 2037e856 (git archive in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/vmtip):
  - A pwsh step running `node mine/spawn-ps51.mjs scripts\tests\postflight-vm-route.ps1`, which does spawnSync('powershell', ['-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File', script]), stops after 2 s at its first row:
    [vm candidate] R1: one changed file becomes one checkpoint commit, hooks never run
    SPAWN-PS51 status=2
    The term 'Get-FileHash' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, ...
  - The same file started by pwsh directly (`powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\postflight-vm-route.ps1`) prints "PASS postflight-vm-route.ps1" in 140 s.
  Logs: logs/vmA-01-*.log, vmB-01-*.log, vmT-01-*.log; spawner mine/spawn-ps51.mjs.
- A one-line probe, node spawnSync('powershell', ['-Command', '(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath C:\Windows\win.ini -Algorithm SHA256).Hash']) under pwsh, prints "Get-FileHash : The term 'Get-FileHash' is not recognized" (logs/vmA-02-*.log).

FIX DIRECTION
- Test-only. Replace the three Get-FileHash calls with a .NET SHA-256 helper, as postflight.ps1's Get-Sha256Hex (:2208-2215) and moe-agent.ps1's Get-MoeSha256Hex already do: [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(), ComputeHash over [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes, Dispose, plus postflight.ps1's IOException retry.
- Return the same upper-case hex string, so the before/after snapshot comparisons keep their meaning.
- No other scripts/**/*.ps1 calls Get-FileHash (grep at fec9a842).

FILES: scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1 only.

PLACEMENT: 1dfec7a4, bbd7ad2d and cd3887fe all hold scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1 and are WORKING (lanes at 11:55Z), so this row depends on all three. None of their current hunks touch Get-VmcControl, Get-VmcWFiles or Get-VmcWIndex. Line numbers move, so find the three calls with `grep -n Get-FileHash` at plan time.
definitionOfDone: Run from a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout, a pwsh step that has node start Windows PowerShell 5.1 on the file (`pwsh -NoProfile -Command "node -e \"process.exitCode=require('child_process').spawnSync('powershell',['-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1'],{stdio:'inherit'}).status\""`) prints "PASS postflight-vm-route.ps1" and exits 0.

`pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1` and, started from pwsh, `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1` each still print "PASS postflight-vm-route.ps1".
